name: OrganisationIdentificationRule
text: In case of conflict between the Organisation Identification and the Full Legal Name, it is recommended that the account servicer ask for clarification by means of an AdditionalInformationRequest message.

name: ClosedStatus1Rule
text: If Closed is present then Enabled is not allowed.

name: EnabledDisabledStatus1Rule
text: If Enabled is present, then Disabled is not allowed.

name: EnabledDisabledStatus2Rule
text: If Disabled is present, then Enabled is not allowed.

name: ClosedStatus3Rule
text: If Closed is present then Pending is not allowed.

name: ClosedStatus2Rule
text: If Closed is present then Disabled is not allowed.

name: ClosedStatus4Rule
text: If Closed is present then PendingOpening is not allowed.

name: ClosedStatus5Rule
text: If Closed is present then Proforma is not allowed.

name: ClosedStatus6Rule
text: If Closed is present then ClosurePending is not allowed.

name: StatusElementRule
text: One of the elements (Enabled, Disabled, Pending, PendingOpening, Proforma, Closed, ClosurePending, Other) must be present.

name: PartialHoldingUnits1Rule
text: If BlockHolding is NPRH (NonPartialHolding) then PartialHoldingUnits must not be present.

name: PartialHoldingUnits2Rule
text: If BlockHolding is PRTH (PartialHolding) then PartialHoldingUnits is mandatory.

name: PartialHoldingUnits3Rule
text: If BlockHolding is CERT (Certificate) then PartialHoldingUnits must not be present.

name: HoldingCertificateNumberRule
text: If BlockHolding is CERT (Certificate) then HoldingCertificateNumber is mandatory.

name: IdentificationGuideline
text: It is recommended that ISIN is used in Identification.|When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

name: FinancialInstrumentDetailsGuideline
text: FinancialInstrumentDetails may be present if a single investment fund is associated to the investment account. If several investment funds are associated to the investment account, the FundFamilyName only should be specified.

name: IncomePreferenceReinvestment1Rule
text: If IncomePreference is CASH (Cash), then ReinvestmentDetails is not allowed.

name: ReinvestmentPercentage1Rule
text: Sum of all occurrences of ReinvestmentDetails/ReinvestmentPercentage must not be greater than 100.

name: AmountRule
text: If Quantity/Amount is not present, then GrossAmountIndicator is not allowed.

name: OrganisationElementRule
text: One of the elements (Name, ShortName, Identification, LegalEntityIdentifier, Purpose, RegistrationCountry, RegistrationDate, PostalAddress, TypeOfOrganisation, PlaceOfListing) must be present.

name: OwnershipBeneficiaryRateRule
text: Either Rate or Fraction must be present. Both may be present.

name: PoliticallyExposedPersonTypeRule
text: If PoliticallyExposedPersonType/Code is 'NoPoliticalExposure' (NPEX) then PoliticallyExposedPersonStatus is not allowed.

name: MailingIndicatorRule
text: If RegistrationAddressIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then MailingIndicator must be "true" or "1".

name: ReferredPlacementAgentRule
text: ReferredPlacementAgent may only be present if Referred is REFR (Referred).

name: InvestmentAccountRule
text: If ConfirmationDetails/ConfirmationType/Code is ACCO (AccountOpening), then InvestmentAccount must be present.

name: UnitRule
text: If SavingsInvestmentPlan is present, then SavingsInvestmentPlan/Quantity/Unit is not allowed.

name: ReasonElementRule
text: Either Code or AdditionalInformation must be present. Both may be present.

text: It is recommended that ISIN is used in Identification.|When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

name: FinancialInstrumentDetailsGuideline
text: ModifiedFinancialInstrumentDetails/FinancialInstrumentDetails may be present if a single investment fund is associated to the investment account. If several investment funds are associated to the investment account, the FundFamilyName only should be specified.

name: ReinvestmentPercentageRule
text: Sum of all occurrences of ReinvestmentDetails/ReinvestmentPercentage must not be greater than 100.

name: IncomePreferenceReinvestmentRule
text: If IncomePreference is CASH (Cash), then ReinvestmentDetails is not allowed.

name: AccountElementRule
text: One of the elements (AccountStatusUpdateInstruction, Name, Designation, Type, OwnershipType, TaxExemption, StatementFrequency, ReferenceCurrency, Language, IncomePreference, ReinvestmentDetails, TaxWithholdingMethod, TaxReporting, LetterIntentDetails, AccumulationRightReference, RequiredSignatoriesNumber, FundFamilyName, ModifiedFinancialInstrumentDetails, RoundingDetails, Account Servicer, BlockedStatus, AccountUsageType, ForeignStatusCertification, AccountSignatureDateTime, TransactionChannelType, InvestmentAccountCategory, Pledging, Collateral, ThirdPartyRights, PowerOfAttorneyLevelOfControl, AccountingStatus, OpeningDate, ClosingDate, NegativeIndicator, ProcessingOrder, Liability, ModifiedInvestorProfile, FiscalYear) must be present.

name: AccountDataElementRule
text: One of the elements (Name, Designation, FundType, FundFamilyName, SecurityDetails, AccountOwner, Intermediary, Account Servicer) must be present.

name: InstructionDetailsElementRule
text: One of the elements (ModificationReason, AccountApplicationIdentification, ClientReference, CounterpartyReference, ExistingAccountIdentification) must be present.

name: AmountRule
text: If Quantity/Amount is not present, then GrossAmountIndicator is not allowed.

name: OrganisationElementRule
text: One of the elements (Name, ShortName, Identification, LegalEntityIdentifier, Purpose, RegistrationCountry, RegistrationDate, ModifiedPostalAddress, TypeOfOrganisation, PlaceOfListing) must be present.

name: OrganisationIdentificationRule
text: Either Identification or Legal Entity Identifier must be present. Both Identification and Legal Entity Identifier may be present.

name: UnitRule
text: If ModifiedSavingsInvestmentPlan is present, then ModifiedSavingsInvestmentPlan/InvestmentPlan/Quantity/Unit is not allowed.

name: FinancialInstrumentDetailsGuideline
text: FinancialInstrumentDetails may be present if a single investment fund is associated to the investment account. If several investment funds are associated to the investment account, the FundFamilyName only should be specified.

name: ReinvestmentPercentage1Rule
text: Sum of all occurrences of ReinvestmentDetails/ReinvestmentPercentage must not be greater than 100.

name: IncomePreferenceReinvestment1Rule
text: If IncomePreference is CASH (Cash), then ReinvestmentDetails is not allowed.

name: InvestmentAccountIdentificationRule
text: If InstructionDetails/OpeningType/Code is SUPA (SupplementaryAccountOpening), then InvestmentAccount/Identification must be present and must contain the identification of the main account to which the supplementary account is related.

name: UnitRule
text: If SavingsInvestmentPlan is present, then SavingsInvestmentPlan/Quantity/Unit is not allowed.

name: ContractDates1Rule
text: ContractDates/TargetGoLiveDate and ContractDates/GoLiveDate should not be used as part of an account closing process.

name: ContractDates2Rule
text: ContractDates/ClosingDate should not be used as part of an account opening and maintenance process.

name: UltimateCreditorGuideline
text: UltimateCreditor may only be present if different from Creditor.

name: UltimateDebtorGuideline
text: UltimateDebtor may only be present if different from Debtor.

name: IntermediaryAgent2Rule
text: If IntermediaryAgent2 is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

name: IntermediaryAgent3Rule
text: If IntermediaryAgent3 is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

name: InstructionForCreditorAgentRule
text: If InstructionForCreditorAgent/Code contains CHQB, then CreditorAccount is not allowed.

name: PaymentTypeInformationRule
text: If PaymentTypeInformation is present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/PaymentTypeInformation is not allowed.

name: ChequeInstructionRule
text: If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Cheque), then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction is not allowed.

name: ChargesAccountRule
text: If ChargesAccountAgent is present, then ChargesAccount must be present.

name: ChargesAccountAgentRule
text: If ChargesAccountAgent is present, then it must contain a branch of the DebtorAgent. It must not contain a completely different agent.

name: UltimateDebtorGuideline
text: UltimateDebtor may only be present if different from Debtor.

name: ChequeInstructionDeliverToDebtorGuideline
text: If CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is present and if CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod/Code is CRDB (CourierToDebtor), MLDB (MailToDebtor), PUDB (PickUpByDebtor) or RGDB (RegisteredMailToDebtor), then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliverTo may only be present if different from Debtor.

name: ChequeInstructionDeliverToCreditorGuideline
text: If PaymentInformation/CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is present and is CRCD (CourierToCreditor), MLCD (MailToCreditor), PUCD (PickUpByCreditor) or RGCD (RegisteredMailToCreditor), then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliverTo may only be present if different from CreditTransferTransactionInformation/Creditor.

name: ChequeInstructionDeliverToCreditorAgentGuideline
text: If CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is present and is CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent) or RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliverTo may only be present if different from CreditTransferTransactionInformation/Creditor.

name: ChequeFromGuideline
text: CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/ChequeFrom may only be present if different from CreditTransferTransactionInformation/UltimateDebtor or Debtor.

name: ChargeBearerRule
text: If ChargeBearer is present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChargeBearer is not allowed.|If CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChargeBearer is present, then ChargeBearer is not allowed.|CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChargeBearer and ChargeBearer may both be absent.

name: UltimateDebtorRule
text: If UltimateDebtor is present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/UltimateDebtor is not allowed.|If CreditTransferTransactionInformation/UltimateDebtor is present, then UltimateDebtor is not allowed.|CreditTransferTransactionInformation/UltimateDebtor and UltimateDebtor may both be absent.

name: ChequeAndCreditorAccountRule
text: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque), then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAccount is not allowed.

name: ChequeDeliveryAndCreditorAgentRule
text: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque) and CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod/Code is present and is equal to MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent) or PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAgent must be present.

name: ChequeDeliveryAndNoCreditorAgentRule
text: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque) and CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod/Code is present and different from MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent) or PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAgent is not allowed.

name: NonChequePaymentMethodRule
text: If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Cheque) and CreditTransferTransactionInformation/Creditor is not present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAccount must be present.

name: ChequeNoDeliveryAndNoCreditorAgentRule
text: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque) and CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is not present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAgent is not allowed.

name: LinkedReferenceOrAccountApplicationIdentificationRule
text: Either LinkedReference or AccountApplicationIdentification must be present.

name: PreviousReferenceGuideline
text: If PreviousReference/MessageName is present, it must start with acmt.001 or acmt.003 and PreviousReference/Reference must contain the business reference of a message.

name: OtherReferenceGuideline
text: OtherReference should be used for an account opening or an account modification instruction sent in a proprietary way or for system references. |If OtherReference is present, OtherReference/MessageName must contain, for example, 'fax' or 'phone' or 'email'.
